raw_response:

2. The figure does not show “random layers + permute” at ~70%; it’s around ~81%. Compared to “embedding” (~80–82 depending on the bar), it is roughly similar or slightly higher.

3. Statistical significance is not provided (no error bars, confidence intervals, or p-values), so it can’t be determined from the figure. Visually, “random layers” (~81–82) is higher than “random” (~72–74), suggesting a meaningful improvement in magnitude, but significance can’t be confirmed.
